mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 declines by more than 1% over 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 1% signals accelerating economic activity, which increases corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO rises by more than 1% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces corporate profit margins and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% over 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.25% signals tightening monetary policy, which increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25% over 3 months.
